verdict.rationale: Qodo documents configuration as code through a `.pr_agent.toml` file at the repository, project, group, or organization level (qodo-docs-11, qodo-docs-36), so a versioned in-repo config file exists. It also offers ready-made review presets (Minimal, Standard, Comprehensive, Custom) and org-to-repo overrides (qodo-docs-9, qodo-docs-10, qodo-docs-50), but those are tied to the portal, which the docs call the recommended configuration route (qodo-docs-35). The evidence never shows path filters or per-path instructions. Missing for 10: path filters/ignore globs, per-path review instructions, review profiles definable in the repo config file, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
